goal: Verified heritage Passport in frontend/src/app/dai-noi/ho-chieu/ and backend/routers/progress.py.
summary: Implemented verified Heritage Passport architecture with server-authenticated check-in and QR code cryptographic provenance verification (HMAC-SHA256). Added database model HeritagePassportStamp and additive migration 0074_heritage_passport_stamps.py. Enforced key invariant where a physical or authorized visit stamp never grants academic curriculum mastery (UnlockStatus.mastered), which remains strictly gated by passing academic assessment quizzes (score >= 80%). Guarded against negative abuse by ensuring client-claimed statuses (client_claimed_status='mastered') and fake local client completions in browser localStorage are strictly excluded from teacher analytics and verified passport stamps.

invariants_enforced.server_authenticated_checkin: All passport stamps require authenticated server verification; unauthenticated check-ins return HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
invariants_enforced.qr_code_provenance_verification: Validates HMAC-SHA256 signatures issued by authorized heritage bodies (e.g. HMCC_HUE_HERITAGE); rejects tampered signatures, expired tokens, unrecognized authorities, and mismatched sites with HTTP 400 Bad Request.
invariants_enforced.visit_stamp_distinct_from_assessed_maste: A verified visit stamp records physical/verified presence, generating an immutable SHA-256 provenance hash; it NEVER grants UnlockStatus.mastered or mastery XP.
invariants_enforced.negative_abuse_fake_client_claim_defense: Client-claimed statuses (e.g. client_claimed_status='mastered') passed during check-in are strictly ignored, ensuring no shortcut past academic evaluations.
invariants_enforced.negative_abuse_fake_local_completion_exc: Teacher analytics (/api/v1/progress/passport/classroom/{classroom_id}) queries strictly server-persisted verified stamps (is_verified=True); fake localStorage client modifications are completely excluded.
invariants_enforced.anti_replay_idempotent_visits: Repeated check-ins increment checkin_count and update last_visited_at, but award 0 duplicate XP.
invariants_enforced.monument_catalog_parity: All 16 monuments in Hue Imperial City cataloged across 4 spatial zones with Vietnamese names, Han-Nom names, and historical construction metadata.

changes.description: Added HeritagePassportStamp model with UUID primary key, foreign key to users.id, site_slug, zone_slug, verification_method, provenance_hash, authority, checkin_count, is_verified, and unique constraint on (user_id, site_slug).
Created purely additive migration for heritage_passport_stamps table, unique constraints, and indexes.
Updated test database bootstrap DDL to ensure heritage_passport_stamps table and indexes exist during isolated test executions.

Created comprehensive heritage passport domain service featuring IMPERIAL_MONUMENTS_CATALOG (16 monuments across 4 zones), generate_qr_token, verify_qr_token with HMAC-SHA256 cryptographic provenance checks, process_server_checkin enforcing visit stamp != assessed mastery, get_verified_passport, and get_teacher_classroom_passport_analytics excluding fake client completions.

Added Pydantic schemas: PassportCheckInRequest, PassportStampDetailOut, PassportCheckInResponse, PassportVerificationRequest, PassportVerificationResponse, VerifiedPassportOut, StudentPassportSummaryOut, and ClassroomPassportAnalyticsOut.
Added endpoints: POST /api/v1/progress/passport/check-in, POST /api/v1/progress/passport/verify-qr, GET /api/v1/progress/passport, and GET /api/v1/progress/passport/classroom/{classroom_id}.
Added backward-compatible POST /api/v1/imperial/passport/unlock bridge endpoint for legacy frontend background syncing.

Enhanced PassportClient with server-authenticated check-in dialog, QR provenance verification, verified badge indicators, distinct display of verified visit stamps vs assessed masteries, and heritage authentication policy banner.

Created comprehensive 10-test suite verifying catalog completeness, server-authenticated check-in, anti-replay idempotency, cryptographic QR provenance verification and tamper resistance, visit stamp distinction from assessed mastery, negative abuse fake claim defense, and fake local completion exclusion from teacher analytics.
